Landscape Design & Construction in the Blue Mountains

Full design-and-build landscaping for Blue Mountains homes — we plan it, we build it, and you get one accountable local team from first sketch to final planting.

A great Mountains garden starts with a plan that respects the block — the slope, the aspect, the soil and how you actually want to use the space. We design around all of it, then build it with our own crew.

From a simple courtyard to a full backyard transformation with levels, walls, paving and planting, we handle the lot and keep you updated the whole way.

What’s included

  • On-site consultation and concept design
  • Detailed plans, levels and plant selection
  • Earthworks, drainage and structural work
  • Paving, walls, steps and features
  • Planting, turf and finishing
  • One crew, one point of contact

Why Blue Mountains Landscapers

We build for Mountains conditions every day — slope, sandstone, cold and bushfire zones. You get one accountable local crew, a clear fixed quote, and work built to last. Right now every job comes with 20% off for spring and summer.

Hard Landscaping in the Blue Mountains

The built structure of your garden — paths, patios, steps and stonework — engineered for Mountains slope and weather.

Hard landscaping is everything you build rather than plant: the paths you walk, the patio you sit on, the steps that tie a sloping block together. On a Mountains block it has to be built for drainage and movement.

We construct it to last, with proper bases, drainage and materials suited to the conditions up here.

What’s included

  • Paths, patios and courtyards
  • Steps and terracing for slopes
  • Stone and feature walls
  • Proper bases and drainage
  • Edging and finishing
  • Materials suited to the Mountains

Gutter Cleaning in the Blue Mountains

Leaf and debris clearing to protect your home — especially important up here before storm and bushfire season.

Mountains homes sit under a lot of trees, and blocked gutters mean water damage and, in summer, a real fire risk. We clear gutters fully and safely.

A quick, affordable job that protects your home — book it in before the season turns.

What’s included

  • Full gutter and downpipe clearing
  • Leaf and debris removal
  • Important before fire season
  • Safe access and clean-up
  • One-off or seasonal
  • Photos of the finished job on request
